heading: Hi I'm Koshi!
content: I'm a student who likes learning new things and making things, whether that's through drawing, coding or whatever catches my curiosity. I love anime, playing video games especially psycological horror games, and books that leave me thinking long after I've finished reading them. I like to make things that induce some sort of emotion in people. Outside of that I like drawing, playing games and spending time with friends. This corner of the Internet is where I keep track of books I read, the thougts they leave me with and things I want to remember.
(I'm still writing review of some books so that space is empty)
